title: The Peninsula Tokyo: Central Tokyo With a Park Across the Street

turns.speaker: advisor
turns.name: Luxury Advisor
turns.text: The Peninsula Tokyo faces the Imperial Palace gardens and Hibiya Park. The thing to understand: it's pure city centre, with a park across the street.

turns.speaker: traveler
turns.name: Candid Traveler
turns.text: Right. And Ginza's about a three-minute walk, so shoppers are set.

turns.speaker: advisor
turns.name: Luxury Advisor
turns.text: Exactly. There's a direct entrance to Hibiya subway station, too. And inside, more than a thousand artworks by about sixty Japanese artists.

turns.speaker: traveler
turns.name: Candid Traveler
turns.text: And the dining? I keep hearing about Peter.

turns.speaker: advisor
turns.name: Luxury Advisor
turns.text: Top floor. It relaunched in October 2025 as Modern French under Chef Yohan Da Costa. Hei Fung Terrace does Cantonese, and afternoon tea in The Lobby comes with live music.

turns.speaker: traveler
turns.name: Candid Traveler
turns.text: So food-focused couples, clearly. Who else?

turns.speaker: advisor
turns.name: Luxury Advisor
turns.text: First-time Tokyo visitors and business travelers. And dog owners: it's pet-friendly, with an actual dog menu.

turns.speaker: traveler
turns.name: Candid Traveler
turns.text: Here's what I'd flag. Older reviews call Peter a steakhouse; that's out of date. And palace views depend on room category, so check yours.

turns.speaker: advisor
turns.name: Luxury Advisor
turns.text: Fair. And fly into Haneda if you can. It's about forty minutes by bus, versus ninety from Narita.

turns.speaker: traveler
turns.name: Candid Traveler
turns.text: One more: the pool's indoors, about twenty metres, with a vitality pool overlooking the palace gardens.

turns.speaker: traveler
turns.name: Candid Traveler
turns.text: So: book it if you want central Tokyo on your doorstep and serious dining upstairs. If you're after a resort escape, look elsewhere.

turns.speaker: advisor
turns.name: Luxury Advisor
turns.text: With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, you get free breakfast for two daily, a priority upgrade if available at check-in, and a $100 hotel credit.

short_version.best_for: First-time Tokyo visitors, shoppers and food-focused couples
short_version.atmosphere: Central city tower facing the Imperial Palace gardens
short_version.worth_knowing: Fly into Haneda; palace views depend on room category
